notes.title: We do not give out keys for this game anymore :'3
notes.content:
Greetings, reader.

Lately we have received a lot of requests for keys to this game, but no work has been done on this game for a long while due to other projects, and the fact that porting this game from an earlier version of Unity to a newer version, or even a different game engine, would take a considerable amount of time.

So why aren't we giving out keys anymore?

For one, it's the new Steam rules regarding handing out keys. We do not want to be on Valve's bad side, and wish to keep our relationship with Valve as good as we can when it comes to this platform for game releases.

For two, it will diminish the value of this game, and can be abused. Imagine if I were to give out 10000 keys to someone. That's per the game's price today a lot of money in potential value. Admittedly, this game has not sold the best and performed that well due to sad happenings during the development, and that we were all pretty poor back then and could not afford to fix anything. However, this is not to say we don't have a certain level of pride in what we have accomplished, and that as a business entity we need to keep track of who we are dealing with and for what purpose. We need to know that the investment of giving out keys will be worth it to us.

So please, don't ask for keys anymore.

Thank you for your time.

notes.title: Stealth update should be live :3c
notes.content:
A potential sequence-breaking bug has been fixed with thanks to input from the user Saraphel.

The bug related to how many items the player would have in the inventory and how many the puzzle would need for your to have to proceed. At a later part of the game you'd have given/spent many of the items and you'd be one item short of being able to solve the puzzle. This has been fixed now.

Thank you to all the users who help with reporting bugs and other issues. [b]:3[/b]

notes.title: New update with some hotfixes coming soon! :'3
notes.content:
Apparently there was a scaling issue with one of the inventory items so it appeared as one pixel large in the inventory screen. This has been fixed.

Also there are some issues if you load a game right after completing the game without exiting and reentering the game first, but it is being looked into now.

Please let me know if you find anything. These bugs were discovered by a player just now and we appreciate your feedback and do what we can in order to fix it.
